scenarios.title: Every built-in install scenario
scenarios.step: e2e/journey/runner.py:agent apply --json for each catalog scenario

scenarios.title: Admin invite, reset link, revocation, and restart persistence
Register and use a project
scenarios.step: e2e/journey/runner.py:kb project add --init plus project-scoped service journey

scenarios.title: Run a workflow, inspect its history/logs, and verify cron execution
scenarios.reason: The runner lints a fixture and probes workflow routes; it does not run a workflow to completion, inspect its run history/logs, or verify a cron firing.

scenarios.title: Open Studio and use it in a browser
Install a store plugin, pin it, run it, and uninstall it
scenarios.reason: Only the registry route is probed; there is no store install, project pin, invocation, and uninstall flow.

scenarios.title: Bind a marketplace adapter to a project slot
scenarios.reason: No journey installs/binds an adapter and exercises the bound capability.

scenarios.title: Link and invoke an author's local plugin
scenarios.reason: No generated or fixture plugin is linked and invoked through the installed CLI.

scenarios.title: Run kb scaffold, build, link, invoke, and pin a plugin
scenarios.reason: The runner does not drive `kb scaffold run` through generated plugin build and invocation; the former HTTP template probe was not a product API.

scenarios.title: Update an installed platform
scenarios.reason: The runner has no second sealed platform version to update to.

scenarios.title: Roll back an installed platform
scenarios.reason: The runner does not create an update snapshot and exercise the rollback command against it.

scenarios.title: Diagnose a broken install
scenarios.step: e2e/journey/runner.py:hide the active receipt, assert doctor --json reports not installed and gives kb-create install, restore receipt
